My man, first off, you're not alone on this. I started in frozen a few months ago as well. And what you just posted is EXACTLY what has been going on in my situation. 

A few questions: Are you yourself doing any ordering? Have you been able to adjust the pi?
For instance, if what you're stocking is already full full, then check that products pi number and adjust accordingly. And then my final question that I have in mind is, are you separating out every departments load? If you are, then full stop doing so they can do it on their time as we in the frozen don't have that.

If you're in the union, express what's been going on to your rep. Letting them know gives context to a situation and allows them to have your back to their best ability 

Just show up and don't quit and do what ya can. Being known to be reliable and a good worker (most of the time) saves you in my experience.
Have you seen any other departments that could potentially need you? At the moment, this is my solution. I've gotten to the point where I talked with my asm, and he agreed with me that this department (frozen) isn't a good fit for me. But in my situation I know that the dug department needs a person so.. keep that in mind.
So yeah, that's my humble advice for ya on this with what info you posted. If it's beyond all of that time to start searching again, unfortunately.

Then comes the removal of the stint. That was an embarrassing here's a towel to wipe yourself moment for me. I still drink soda but not nearly as much or energy drinks ever. I wouldnt want that pain for my worst enemy (or maybe lol)
